name: std::basic_regex<CharT,Traits>::getloc
intro:
Returns the current locale associated with the regular expression.

Effectively calls traits_i.getloc() where traits_i is a default initialized instance of the type Traits, stored within the regular expression object.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The current locale associated with the regular expression.

summary: Returns the current locale associated with the regular expression.
